SELECT concert_id, title, artist, venue, description, thumbnail, status FROM concerts WHERE concert_id = #{concertId}
mapper.update: UPDATE concerts SET title = #{title}, artist = #{artist}, venue = #{venue}, description = #{description, jdbcType=CLOB}, thumbnail = #{thumbnail}, status = #{status} WHERE concert_id = #{concertId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings b JOIN concert_schedules s ON b.schedule_id = s.schedule_id WHERE s.concert_id = #{concertId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM booking_items WHERE booking_id IN ( SELECT b.booking_id FROM bookings b JOIN concert_schedules s ON b.schedule_id = s.schedule_id WHERE s.concert_id = #{concertId} )
DELETE FROM payments WHERE booking_id IN ( SELECT b.booking_id FROM bookings b JOIN concert_schedules s ON b.schedule_id = s.schedule_id WHERE s.concert_id = #{concertId} )
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS RNUM, A.* FROM ( SELECT b.booking_id, b.total_price, b.status AS booking_status, TO_CHAR(b.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at, m.member_id, m.email, m.name AS member_name, c.concert_id, c.title AS concert_title, c.artist, TO_CHAR(s.performance_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS performance_date, COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM bookings b INNER JOIN members m ON b.member_id = m.member_id INNER JOIN concert_schedules s ON b.schedule_id = s.schedule_id INNER JOIN concerts c ON s.concert_id = c.concert_id
AND b.status = #{status}
AND LOWER(m.email) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND LOWER(m.name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND LOWER(c.title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND ( LOWER(m.email) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(m.name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(c.title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
ORDER BY b.booking_id DESC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= #{END} ) WHERE RNUM >= #{START}
